what: Mute Video removes the sound track from a video file, so you get the same video with no audio at all.

In the fast mode the picture is copied without re-encoding. That means it takes only seconds even for long videos, and the image quality stays exactly the same. You can also choose to make a standard H.264 MP4, which plays on every device.
The work is done in your browser with FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly, so the video is never uploaded.
uses: Remove wind, traffic or chatter before adding music in another app.
Take out private conversations before sharing a clip.
Post a silent clip and add a song inside Instagram or TikTok.
Use a silent video in slides so it does not play sound over your talk.
Prepare silent footage for a video edit.
tutorial: Click the box or drop a video onto it. You will see its name, size, length, picture size and whether it has sound.
The video appears in a player (muted). If your browser cannot preview the format, you can still remove the sound.
"Fast, no quality loss" copies the picture and keeps the same format. "Make a standard MP4" re-encodes, which is slower but useful if the result must play on an old device.
Press "Remove sound". Fast mode usually finishes in a few seconds.
Press "Download silent video". The file is named like holiday-no-sound.mp4.
features: MP4 stays MP4, MOV stays MOV, WebM stays WebM.
If fast mode is not possible, a standard MP4 is made.

example.title: Worked example: a silent clip for Instagram
example.text: Lina filmed a 2-minute sunset video at the beach (sunset.mov, 380 MB), but the wind is very loud. She drops it on the box, keeps "Fast, no quality loss" and presses "Remove sound". About five seconds later she downloads sunset-no-sound.mov, the same quality and slightly smaller, and adds music to it in Instagram.

tips: Use fast mode first; it is quicker and keeps the exact quality.
If the silent video will not play on an older TV or phone, run it again with "Make a standard MP4".
To remove the sound from only part of a video, cut it first with the Video Trimmer.
If the info line says "no sound", the video has no audio track already.
problems: It says the video already has no sound
There is no audio track in the file, so there is nothing to remove.
The file could not be read
It may be damaged or still being copied. Try copying it again, or another browser.
The result is an MP4 instead of my format
Fast mode could not write your format, so a standard MP4 was made instead. It plays everywhere.
The engine could not be downloaded
The video engine (about 32 MB) downloads the first time you use any of the video tools. After that your browser keeps it, so it starts quickly. Check your connection and try again.
